verdict.rationale: Kit's API and MCP support drafting/scheduling broadcasts to a segment (kit-docs-1, kit-docs-2, kit-docs-5) and the Kit MCP lets an AI client read/write to an account (kit-docs-20, kit-docs-29), which covers agent-drafted campaigns targeted at segments. However, there is no explicit documentation of a human-approval gate or 'queued for review' workflow distinct from direct scheduling/sending — the evidence shows draft-or-schedule but not an approval-before-send mechanism. missing for 10: explicit approval/review workflow documentation, evidence of a pending-approval state distinct from scheduled/sent, and independent confirmation of this human-in-the-loop pattern.
